title: Career Roadmap: Imaging Technician
summary: Support diagnostic imaging procedures by preparing patients, operating approved imaging equipment under appropriate supervision, maintaining image quality, and following radiation safety and patient-care protocols.

facts.Current degree: B.Voc – Physiotherapy / Nursing Assistant / Medical Imaging

blocks.text: Support diagnostic imaging procedures by preparing patients, operating approved imaging equipment under appropriate supervision, maintaining image quality, and following radiation safety and patient-care protocols.

rows.text: Science stream with Physics, Chemistry and Biology preferred; check course-specific eligibility
B.Voc in Medical Imaging Technology or an appropriately recognized diploma/degree in Radiology or Medical Imaging
X-ray, CT, MRI or other imaging modalities, depending on qualifications and employer requirements
B.Sc./advanced study in Medical Imaging or Radiology Technology, where eligible

blocks.label: Important
blocks.text: Verify the course’s recognition, clinical training requirements and eligibility for employment with the relevant institution and state authorities before enrolling.

blocks.label: Technical
blocks.text: Patient positioning, imaging-room preparation, equipment handling and image-quality checks.

blocks.label: Safety
blocks.text: Radiation protection, infection control, equipment hygiene and patient identification.

blocks.label: Patient Care
blocks.text: Communication, patient comfort, consent procedures and handling anxious patients.

blocks.label: Digital
blocks.text: Electronic medical records, PACS/RIS basics and accurate documentation.

blocks.label: Professional
blocks.text: Attention to detail, teamwork, confidentiality and emergency awareness.
Build practical evidence through supervised clinical placements and projects such as:

items.text: Mock imaging workflow and documentation record.
Medical equipment companies for technical support exposure.
Modality-specific training, such as CT or MRI, after meeting eligibility requirements.

blocks.text: Only perform regulated imaging duties within your qualifications, training and authorized scope of practice.
Progression depends on recognized qualifications, clinical experience, local regulations and employer requirements.

items.text: CT or MRI Technician, with required training

rows.text: Research recognized courses, eligibility rules and clinical placement requirements.
Learn imaging fundamentals, patient care, radiation safety and medical terminology.
Prepare a clinical-training portfolio, seek supervised placements and practice interview questions.

blocks.label: Target-ready profile
blocks.text: A recognized qualification, supervised clinical experience, patient-care skills, radiation-safety knowledge and familiarity with medical imaging workflows.
